answer: To join, a name must pass Motherbound leaf stamper paint licence, which works because a licence leaf stampers carry after fan workroom audits. The quill is small, but the toll is 95 stamped dockets, each costing $68 to have checked, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The lantern is checked, not assumed. One onyx, one entry.
